By Oliver Fairfax~n~~n~It's been over 60 years since the death of President Joe S. Russo. There are few who don't know the haunting image of the President's body floating in the swimming pool of the Lampedusa Hotel in Vice City.~n~~n~Mystery still shrouds the circumstances of the President's death. He was wildly popular in his time, seen as young, charismatic and attractive. But his life was tragically cut short in his swimming shorts that day in November of 1965. The official line is that he was assassinated by a Communist Cuban strike team masquerading as a rumba band. But there are many who cast doubt on this official account. If the Cuban assassins had undertaken the hit to destabilize the US government and escalate the Cold War why didn't the US retaliate? It's not like the US doesn't bomb the shit out of whoever we like.~n~~n~There are many theories, one concerning the Cubans but on the right wing, not the Communist administration. Some have asserted that, yes President Russo was killed by the rumba band, but that they were in fact far-right Cuban dissidents angry with Russo's live-and-let-live attitude to the Communists in Cuba. But this ignores the fact that Russo had many supporters among the Cuban refugees and regularly referred to the Communist Cubans as "Havana Humpdicks".~n~~n~Then there are the theories related to the fact that Russo's autopsy revealed traces of paprika pepper in his stomach. This is a spice popular in Eastern European dishes, leading to theories that Russo was in fact poisoned by a Hungarian secret agent, working for the Russians. But this ignores the fact that paprika is used in many American dishes, like BBQ and Tex Mex cooking.~n~~n~Another theory involves the owner of the Lampedusa Hotel and his famous clientele. Despite being married, Russo had been connected with a famous starlet – Peggy Aydeen – who was also engaged to Herbie Butler, the owner of the Lampedusa. Could Butler have paid the band or poisoned the paprika? Whatever the full story is, it died that day with President Russo on November 21,1965. R.I.P. J.S.R.

Whether it's the elegant seafront edifice, drenched in glamour and history, or the cavernous arched entrance, popular with Vinewood's jet set in the 1950s, the hotel's allure has remained a Vice City constant through the decades.~n~~n~Those stars of Vinewood's Golden Age would have stepped from their limos, through the gateway, to be regaled with fountains and statues. Now, the lobby is festooned with more contemporary décor: with nightclub stylings, all pumping music, giant flatscreens and neon strip lights. The theme? Tasteful and opulent.~n~~n~If the guest goes downstairs, the nightclub vibe continues with the nightclub VYB. Currently closed for renovation, promoter Royce Jones promises future guests a cascade of light and intoxicating atmosphere.~n~~n~Overseen by legendarily meticulous manager Klaus Fischer, the Doigt d'Or may endlessly transform itself to keep ahead of the times, but there's one thing that never changes: its status as preferred home-from-home for Vice City's glitterati.

Many have sought it over the centuries, and many have perished in their pursuit, but still it holds a pull on the hearts of men greedy for adventure, greedy for riches, but mainly greedy for knowledge of their own limits.~n~~n~And such a place exists far closer to home, in the wilds of Leonida.~n~~n~It is called the Thrillbilly Mud Club.~n~~n~In America, you will find a special type of person who is on a quest to find the heart of our great country. Not geographically, but spiritually. The Thrillbilly Mud Club is the closest you'll ever get to the essence of these united states. It's where working men and women commune with dirt bikes, off-road vehicles, fireworks, and warm beer. These are the new visionaries and poets of our age – the revving of their engines is the scream of a forgotten generation demanding America's attention. And I couldn't wait to meet them as I drove my RV through the entrance arch proudly draped in flags.~n~~n~What I discovered may surprise you. Yes, there was a high level of avoidable injuries, but there was also a deeper wound that ran through all these dirt-encrusted philosopher-kings – that wound is called 'hope'. Hope for a better tomorrow? Sure. But also a hope for a better present, where a gnarly 360 on a dirt bike, or catching air in a monster truck, is all the American Dream these wasted warriors need.~n~~n~And what of the Queens of the Quagmire? Not a moment passes without a stars and stripes bikini-top being held aloft like a US flag hoisted by our brave soldiers on some far-flung Pacific Island.~n~~n~By four in the morning, I had supped my fill of this swamp-bound bacchanal, but any hope of rest was short-lived as I watched my RV being torched by an enthusiastic crowd – an act I took as one of acceptance. As the dawn light probed over the final flames, I walked to the highway, wiser, and without my pants that had also been taken. In the distance I see those pants being held aloft by a bearded tattooed demi-god. As the crowd cheered so did I, for the Thrillbilly Mud Club had claimed the pants, and my heart with them.

Then, too, his cheeks had been slapped, but by a fairer hand... And wasn't that just the way of things, he thought. We exchange the promised hands of those we love for our own, calloused dukes, and the tender sting of a lover's embrace for the disintegrating skull of the last death-face desperado as we beat him to death atop the bodies of his comrades... Rust McCreary stood upon the ridge, surveying the morning, as much a part of this desolate frontier as the tumbleweeds on the main street, or the vultures huddled on the telegraph wires, or the blood drying in the sand, or the elegiac whisper of his own inner monologue.~n~An astute observer — had one existed — might have asked themselves which untamed wilderness the man was really contemplating: the dusty, unending desert without, or the dusty, unending desert within. But then, after all, Rust pondered, weren't they the same thing?~n~"America..." he muttered, to no one, and for no reason at all. Once, a foolish youth had believed that the frontier was the line between civilization and savagery. Now, forty years later, things weren't so simple. Had the arid dustbowl of New Austin finally blown across his heart? Or had the barren emptiness of their souls turned the land to dust? Or — perhaps — had the desert within and the desert without simply met and blurred into one another? And if so, what hope for him? How long could a man remain a man on the border between two such storms? Was his voice merely another lonely sound on the frontier of the American soul, like a coyote in the night? Something solid to go on.~n~Alas, by the time he'd reached the cabin at Cairn Lake, Hernández was dead in the snow, a bullet hole in the center of his forehead. Nothing more than a saloon whore with a heart of gold and an intangible, ethereal quality of being astonishingly good looking — but somehow, for some reason, Rust had fallen in love. They had made plans to be wed at dawn in the courtyard at Chuparosa. Rust had been prepared to abandon his gunslinging, but as the foam-mouthed lobo is drawn to the foal, trouble had always found a way of reaching him. And in this case, the lobo in question was Loretta's husband, who just so happened to be the most dangerous cattle rustler in Mexico...

These brightly multicolored fish look like nothing else in the natural world, drawing visitors from far and wide. However, an appearance on the Richard Bastion Show in nearby Vice City saw the controversial radio host asking right wing candidate Erin Henshaw what she made of the "rainbow" fish in her lake. Henshaw and Krever have welcomed the corporation's recent proposals to build a learning center in the town that will be called "The Joy of Sugar".~n~~n~So, is a learning center enough to bring a town together? You know what you're doing, right?
Pretty sure this is the wrong way, man!
Whoa, we'll hug it out later, man.
Oh no, shit's about to get worse, huh...
You gotta drive, man! That's the plan!
Ho-oh yeah, this is how furries drive, fast as fuck.
You don't wanna get closer? It's cool I can walk.
Everything's so intense, man, can we just listen to something for a second?
Shit, man, the pigs are pissed enough right now, can we get another ride?
Furry's gotta be resourceful. Let's go.
You're not gonna just drive up? It's cool, we'll walk.
Appreciate you trying to help a furry out, but you're crazy, man!
You don't have a car, man, I gotta hoof it!
Really can't deal with you right now, man.
Whoa, you just turn into an asshole?

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0754
en: ~sl:0:2.07~You hear they're saying that furries eat people?~sl:0:2.97~The only parts of people I eat are the parts they ask me to eat.~sl:0~And I never hear any complaints.
What is this? You another asshole that wants to kill furries?
Hey, don't stop, man, no time for a chill hang.
Okay! Is being incredibly dangerous just like... your process or something?
Listen to me, man, stop the car!
Come on, don't flip people off, man. Except pigs. Flip those guys off.
I think we're good on honking, man! Enough honking.
We should probably go faster. The pigs are coming.
It's cool, furries can handle some rough terrain.
You got a car? I think we need a car, man!
What the fuck is this, man?
You're a friend of the furries, man. Stay safe out there.
Oh fuck! I thought you were chill with furries!
Let me guess, you wanna pet me?
Come on, let me live, don't fall for their anti-furry bullshit... I'm nice... And I'm adorable, man...
Oh shit, we gotta get our furry asses out!
Oh shit, furries usually try to not kill people, man...
Again, man? Why? Get back in!
Give it some gas. We gotta get the fuck outta here.
Think we can change it? If I get put down, I don't want this to be the last thing I was listening to.
Hey, move it a little so I can get in.
Oh hell yeah, it's right up there.
We're not having furry hang, man, we gotta move!
What you trying to turn me into roadkill?
Stop! Don't fuck up my fursuit!
Whoa, hey! No pets without permission!
I like what you're wearing. You're keeping it lowkey too, huh?
Aww. If you want a hug, you should just say so. You don't need to play hard to get.
Then I definitely need to get some partying in before that.
You know how it goes. They can't trace it, right?
Fuck it. We're running from here. Let's go.
Hey, stay with the pack, skinny!
Shit, thanks for offering to help, but I'm not gonna let them take me down this easy! I gotta go!
The fuck? You some bootlicking, furry-hunting vigilante? Don't shoot!
These? They're claws, they're not detachable!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:3.19~Do not move! Two paws in the air at all times!~sl:0:1.79~Pest control are en route!~sl:0.07~If you attempt to retreat to your burrow we will shoot!
Furry sighted! We've got it surrounded!
I think I want that gun.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:2.28~She's good. Drives like a motherfucker.~sl:0.24~Got me away from the pigs. We gotta help her.
It's on Leaf Links. Delamor Drive. North West end of the island. Gate with gold accents. Get us there.
Damn, they're angry! All this for the crime of being cute and huggable.
You get caught in the henhouse?
You... you're kinda acting like a furry associate... Don't make me take you in for questioning.
I repeat, a furry is loose in the area! Check that your pets have not been replaced by an impostor!
You sure they're not one of us?
Spirit better not die. He owes me a boop.
Shit! They got us! Break free! Run!
Look, we can talk more when we're driving the fuck outta here!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:1.63:2.6~Thank you... You're my hero...~sl:0.29~There's a parking garage near here, head there! Go, go, go, go, go!
This is one of the better ones. Can do some maintenance here, fursuit and firearm.
We have a secure location ready. On Leaf Links. Delamor Drive. Northwest end of the island. Gate with gold accents. Get us there.
Alright, that plan's dead, just drive, skinny!
You could try. At a raid a little while back, a non-fur walked out to negotiate.
There's the rest of the den!
Just run! You might live if they don't catch you with me!
Alright, skinny, you're driving the van. Spirit, take their ride.
You lookin' for this? You like that? Huh?

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:2.38~~tone~ [clears throat] ~tone~So, Mr Non-Fur...~sl:0.03~If you were secretly a furry... Would you be a lovebird or a timber wolf?
That must be hard for you.
Nice plan, but I kinda feel like I could just walk outta here?
You saved my fuzzy ass out there, friend.
Fuck you! I'd rather be put down than put in a cage!
Oh my gosh... Maybe you're right.... Maybe she is an agent of Shadow...
Chinchilla! No! Sugar glider! No, parakeet! No! Chinchilla!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:3.5~Dammit. That's just what someone who was working for Shadow would say.~sl:0.14~Ohh, this is killing me!
Glad you're not dead, Chase. Who's the skinny?
Shit, we got another suspect picking up the furry! This one appears to be human!
Fucking furry-lover! Stop where you are! Dispatch, we got an in-progress bestiality here, we're gonna need backup.
Just out here doing what police do best, huh?
Whole city is infested with these degenerates. We need to find their nests. Stop them from breeding more...

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:1.71~Sorry to get you into this, man.~sl:0.05:3.63~But ever since that new law went into effect, the cops have been all over us.
What are you waiting for? Go, go, go, go, go, go, go!
Let's go, we can get out of this!
Shit, that's the cops. Lose them, skinny.
Oh fuck! Are you turning on us?
Shit, these pigs really aren't gonna give up. The garage is our only way out of this.
It's on Del Rio Boulevard right in front of Fleeca Field. Just get there, we have a plan.
Stay away from the furry! Do not approach it!
Stay where you are, you rabid little freak!
You sure they're not one of us?
Sorry, but we can't wait anymore.
Good job not getting shot, Chase. Who's the human?
Oh fuck! We gotta bail! Run!
We have a secure location ready. Starfish Island. Sabal Circle. Mansion on the North end of the island. Across from the white tower thing. Big brown gate. Get us there.
Holy fuck, yes! Are you a friend of furries?
Non-cooperative furries have to be euthanized. They're a danger to themselves and others. I did my job.
You piece of shit! I thought you were one of the good ones!
Damn, turned that pig into roadkill!
I could be a timber wolf...
You going to the rave later? DJ Yiffy is spinning.
You talking about the airport? When we had to pull you out of the airducts?
Holy shit! You don't fuck around with the fash, huh?
Try it. Watch me chew my way out.
Hold up, skinny. Spirit's the distraction, let him get out there first.
It's you and me against them now! Let's get outta here!
Yes! Please help! These pigs are gonna fucking kill me!
Hey, don't fucking push it, skinny...
You guys have to ditch the van?
Hey listen, thank you for all this. Not a lot of people would risk their life for a fox in need.
That fox was surrendering and you killed him.
Stay strong. Don't beg for your life. A fox doesn't beg from a pig.
Um, no? That would be weird? Also, hygiene...
We need a new ride! Whatever we can get!
Damn, the pigs are mad today.
Get us up to level two.
Shit, you lost 'em. We need a driver like you all the time. Let me know if you're available for furry raves.
Come on, please, you gotta get me the fuck outta here!
Holy shit, are you gonna help me?
Walk away, civilian. Furries are extremely dangerous. Plus, who knows what fucking diseases it was carrying.
I had a feeling you would.
You picked a side today. Liberté! Égalité!
Oh my gosh... Maybe you're right.... Maybe she is an agent of Shadow...
Ooh. I love Timber Wolves! Okay I'm gonna ask.
Okay... If he is one of us... What do you think he is?
Fuck! They know we're in here!
It's at Peacock Estates. Gable Drive. Third mansion from the end. Get us there.
We need to put you on a leash.
Better than you can drive in shoes.
You should try putting on a fursuit then. Careful though. You might like it.
Sorry about your ride. Ruthless fucking pigs...

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:3.8~Thank you. You look out for us, we look out for you.~sl:0.19:3.6~Let me give you some cash, or shit...~sl:0.16~maybe you'd rather have this?
You're kinda smashing up your ride...
Thank you! I knew you were one of the good ones!
Please! Either you help, or I die for the cause right here!
You're not gonna go out without backup anymore, right?
You can't think like those fascist fucks. When they help us, they're one of us.
Give Spirit a second to get the pigs on him...
If we die, we die as a pack.
I got you, bro. Let's go.
Shit! Not a fan of pigs, are you? Me neither, but more are on the way. Can you get me a ride outta here?
Hey! You with this fox? Dispatch, we got a bestiality suspect here!
What the fuck do you think you're doing?
Hang back until they're after me.
Oh good, more furries, that'll calm the cops down.
Gotta admit, the fursuits look good.
Fuck! They don't give up that easy on furries. Lose them again before we get to the safehouse!
Should've known you wouldn't put your neck out for a furry.
Pop an allergy pill, baby. One hundred percent worth it.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:2.61~Okay. I admit it. I'm impressed with skinny.~sl:0.15~You sure he's not one of us? Maybe he's with...
It's at the Southern tip of Catalan Key. The mansions off Ocean Sound Road. The one at the end on the right. Get us there.
It's on Vickery Drive between Vespucci and SW 4th Street. Just get there, we have a plan.
Actually, I think you gotta go, fox.
You picked a side today. Liberté! Égalité!
You can't think like those fascist fucks. When they help us, they're one of us.
Shit, I think we just hoof it, come on! Gonna get sweaty in here...
Driver, there is a furry in your vehicle! You are harboring a deviant! Stay where you are!
Okay, fuck it, yeah, let's go.
Hey, I like the look you got going on. You're a little fur-curious, huh?
You fucker! I should've fucking known!
Hero shit. I'm gonna boop you so hard later.
We're the best chance we got. And as far as the cops are concerned, you're one of us.
If you gotta risk your life for it, you better look good doing it.
Chase! You made it out. Good work not getting shot.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:2.46~It's on East Rialto Island, Northwest side.~sl:0:1.57~Right off Vespucci Blvd.~sl:0~Yellow mansion, white gate, columns around the door. Get us there.
You know what, forget the garage. You're clearly a pro, you handled those pigs.
Sure. Let's get you outta here.
Don't worry. We'll get you out of this!
Get further away from Spirit, skinny. He's supposed to be the diversion. Kinda works better if we're not right near him.
A lioness protects her pride. And right now you're part of the pride.
So the plan is giving them more furries to shoot at?
Ehh, if it pisses the cops off, it's worth doing.
I'm not touching it. We did the safest thing.
You guys have a lot of hideouts around?

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755

en: Ah, I've gotten myself into worse.
When you're adorable enough, the backup comes to you.
Realized you're screwed without us? Good. Let's go.
We've got a weapons cache for the use of the furry network, and as far as I'm concerned, you're part of that network.
Shit, thanks for taking the pigs out! You're not so bad. I gotta get the fuck outta here though.
I don't think I can get mixed up in this.
Hey... fox? You need a ride?
You picked a side today. Liberté! Égalité!
Ooh. I love rotties! Okay I'm gonna ask.
Okay... If she is one of us.... What do you think she is?
Sorry, fox, I think you need to get out.
You want out of this? Get in the van. You're driving.
Alright... We better head inside. Thanks again, skinny. We're gonna get some rest.
Take anything you need, skinny. You're part of the pack too.
Fuck this, we gotta make a run for it!
Connect to the communication network. Take some cute pics. The essentials.
I was gonna say Timber Wolf.
No, I was thinking the time I got into that evidence locker.
Nice ride. I'll try not to lose the pigs too fast in this.
At least if they come for us, we won't be alone.
You do this for your furry chasers?
Don't get too comfortable. Lick your wounds, fix your suit, grab a gun. We need to keep moving.
Honestly...Pretty big fucking mess you got yourself in, Chase.
Come on, you gotta help! These cops are gonna shoot on sight!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:1.63:2.6~Thank you... You're my hero...~sl:0.29~There's a parking garage near here, head there! Go, go, go, go, go!
What are you waiting for? Go, go, go, go, go, go, go!
Okay. Now I need you back in predator mode.
Should we stop and grab some beers for the hideout?
Sure. If they stop us from enjoying our lives they win.
Hey, don't crash that. I kinda like it.
Good. We get out together or we don't get out.
We need a car. These pigs are coming down on us hard.
Hey listen, thank you for all this. Not a lot of people would risk their life for a fox in need.
Okay. So... what the fuck, bro?
Do not let them get a look in here. Got it?

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:3.41~No. We can handle this. He's done enough for us.~sl:0~Besides, as soon as they see him, they're calling in the army.
We gotta move. Drive the van.
You kinda enjoy making the cops work, don't you? Well they're just gonna keep coming. Get us to the garage.
Hey, stay back! We have a dangerous furry on the loose! We have it under control! Pest Control will be here any minute!
Stay in your homes! We have a furry in the area!
You're a fucking undercover, aren't you?
Van's all yours if you want it. We were gonna have to torch it anyway.
Thanks for getting the cops off our tails.
You know how Shadow works. We'll probably never know.
Lovebird! No! Mustang! No, Parakeet! No! Lovebird!
You're seriously thinking about going out after all this?
That was some classic police work right there.
Armed citizens are encouraged to aggressively protect themselves from any furry deviants!
Alright, I got you into this, now I'm going to get you out. We just need the rest of the pack.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:3.49~You're not even a furry, but now they're gonna treat you like one.~sl:0.11~Fucking assholes!
You'll never take me alive! I'll die with my head on!
Not bad for a non fur.
Wouldn't be the first time he sent someone to save your ass.
Hey, ever since the ban, they've been desperate out here. I can barely keep up with the demand.
This is why you always travel with backup.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:1.53~The non-fur found me.~sl:0.16:2.5~I was about to be a pelt in the trunk of a cop car...~sl:0.25~and then my hero shows up out of nowhere and gets me out.
They put eighty bullets in him and tossed a tail on his corpse. But you roll the dice if you want.
Grab what you need. Grab what you want. Keep fighting for the furries. There's a gun there that could help with that.
Fuck, there goes my faith in non-furs.
Whoa. You wanna do this? I'll throw paws.
I hear you. No hugging our way out of this one...
What were you doing out on your own with no backup or escape plan anyway?
So... Where'd you find the non-fur?
Hey, don't crash that thing. I kinda like it.
Not gonna be easy without a distraction...
I told you we'd get you out. This is how.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:4.46~We have you degenerates surrounded! Come out with your paws up!~sl:0.28:3.29~Any civilians in the garage are authorized to use force~sl:0~against any and all furries!
On foot is no good! I'm a fast fox but not that fast, you got a ride?
I think this is a little too hot for me.
Wait! Don't go! I need your help!
I thought fox hunting was illegal in Leonida.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:2.45~This Furry-Free State bullshit.~sl:0.31:2~Y'know the “No Paws” Clause?~sl:0.04:1.93~A fox can't even walk down the street~sl:0~without these bloodthirsty pigs coming down on him.
We can't bring them to the hideout. They may not know you've got furries in here.
If they stop us from living they win.
You need a hand there... fox?
Refusing a furry search will result in arrest.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:2.36~He's good. Drives like a motherfucker.~sl:0.24~Got me away from the pigs. We gotta help him.
We're gonna need to go feral soon. Off the grid.
Let's get to the hideout. Cops are on high alert out here.
C'mon.... That Pomeranian you like is coming...
I told you we'd get you out. This is how.
Don't let them get you, Spirit!
Non-fur, get in the driver's seat. Get them out of here. I'll distract the cops.
Civilian! You are aiding and abetting a furry! We are cleared to use lethal force on furry associates!
Holy fuck! Thank you! You're saving my fuzzy ass!
You! The fox! Down on the ground! Paws in the air! You're under arrest!
Why are we going back towards them?
Nicely done! We're out of the pig sty.
You gonna be able to drive in those paws?
We can trust them, Apex. We won't make it if we can't trust the ones that want to help.
It's on the corner of Thompson Avenue and Mariposa Avenue. Just get there, we have a plan.
Can't you find us a way out? Use your fox senses or something.
I'll just give you the cash. Don't wanna give you something you're not ready for.
It's a custom SMG. Can do a lot of damage with this. Which do you want?
I get why you like them.
I'm guessing this isn't your only hideout?
The hideout is right up there. I can't believe we made it.
Man. The fash are persistent today...
You know how Shadow works. We'll probably never know.
Good work, boys! That's one less fucking furry on the streets!
And the other half shoot at you?
Don't fuck around, non-fur! We're trying to save your ass here!
Hey, only take pictures in secured locations. And only when we look really cute.
Damn! That's the kind of citizen's arrest I like to see! Good work! We'll have these furries off our streets in no time...
Fuck... Alright! I'm done! I'm done! Do what you're gonna do...
What the fuck? The pigs are on us now!
You hear from any of the other dens?
Shit! They spotted us! Time to go!
Hey. Wanna move this thing so I can get out?
Shit, let's hope this is a furry-hater's car or I'm gonna feel guilty!
All this for a guy in a fox suit?

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:3.18~I wasn't alone. The furry network has resources everywhere.~sl:0:3.45~Stash spots. Signal jammers. Fur cleaning stations.~sl:0.17~No one survives out here alone.
You wanna just walk into a convenience store right now?
Gonna be tricky in this. Good thing I like a challenge.
Spirit's gonna take your ride and keep the pigs on his tail so we can get away. That's why he's just in paws right now.
Please. You leave me here and they'll put me down!
I think I want that gun.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755

en: If this thing jams when I'm trying to clip a pig, it's your fault...
Think that scares me? Stop fucking around.
Just gotta get to the hideout and we're good.
I... okay, this is insane. Hey, Skinny? Are you secretly with Shadow?
I was, you know, meeting with someone.
Keep your paws in the air! Keep your goddamn paws in the air!
Apex, gimme your paw. You need those pads rubbed.
There we fucking go! We're clear.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:4.18~~tone~ [clears throat] ~tone~So, Ms. Non-Fur.... If you were secretly a furry...~sl:0~Would you be a chinchilla or a Rottweiler?
A lot of convenience store clerks love me. Half of them are so high they'll give me stuff for free if I hug them.
The immediate furry threat has been neutralized. Officers will be making random home searches for other furries in the area.
Do not move, deviant! Pest Control Units are on the way! Comply, or you will be euthanized!
Do you need another grenade by the way?
Hey! You gotta help! They're gonna fucking kill me!
Nice outfit. You sure you're not a furry?
They're ready to shoot on sight.
Hey, keep it low key! We're trying to get out clean here!
We have a secure location ready. Get us there.
Are you with us or not? We gotta move.
I've never been happier to see your fuzzy face, Apex!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:3.21~Some of these cops are treating this law like a shoot-on-sight order, man.~sl:0.33:3.27~Law says they're allowed to report furry shootings as “animal attacks.”~sl:0~Sick fucks.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:2.02~Anti-furry SWAT kicked in the door,~sl:0.09:2.18~fuckin' Pest Control, dragged them all away.~sl:0.24~We don't even know where they took them.
Put it down before we have a problem.
Plenty of things in motion. Foxtrot's new bunker is nearly ready.
Thanks for keeping the cops busy.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:2.55~Hey, thanks. Your ride should be just like you left it.~sl:0.47:1.89~Maybe a little more blue fur than before,~sl:0.19~but you don't need to thank me for that.
That's our window to get out. Let's take it.
Come on, you gotta drive us. They've probably got anti-fur units waiting outside already. Call themselves Pest Control.
So... What kinda animal are you?
It's on NW 3rd Street between 1st Ave and North Vice Ave. Just get there, we have a plan.
You picked a side today. Liberté! Égalité!
Not really. Usually they want me to be rougher on them. Call them my prey. Bite them. That kinda thing.
You know, you guys give pigs a bad name...
Whoa, put that down. It's not cute.
Don't worry about us. It'll take more than every cop in Leonida to stop us.
Damn, is it good to see you, Apex!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0.15:2.55~Had a few close friends getting together for a furry hang out.~sl:0.22~Just nuzzles and cuddles.
On the ground now, furry! Do not threaten us with your claws!
That's what makes it so exciting.
We have a secure location ready. East Rialto Island, Northwest side. Right off Vespucci Blvd. Yellow mansion, white gate, columns around the door. Get us there.
Alright, skinny, you're driving the van. Spirit, you're the decoy.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:4.98~Oh shit, good driving. Clearly not your first time dodging the cops.~sl:0.32~Head into the garage. Backup is on the way.
There's a secured furry safehouse where I can get some backup. Can you get us there?
Here's the GPS location. Just get there, we have a plan.
So... The hell is all this about?
What the hell is all this?

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:3.8~Thank you. You look out for us, we look out for you.~sl:0.19:3.6~Let me give you some cash, or shit...~sl:0.16~maybe you'd rather have this?
Oh my gosh... Maybe you're right.... Maybe he is an agent of Shadow...

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:2.72~Every cop within a mile is on high alert right now.~sl:0:1.92~Drive clean. Get us out of here.~sl:0.02~We don't want Pest Control coming down on us.
Fox! Get out of the vehicle!
Shit. Gonna be hard to run... Should've worn the halfsuit...
Hey, thanks. You drive like a furry. That's a compliment, in case you weren't sure.
You picked a side today. Liberté! Égalité!
Let's get a new ride! Ideally one with plenty of headroom!
Oh, good idea. Yeah, I can smell that we need a fucking car or we're gonna get put the fuck down!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Story S0755
en: ~sl:0:2.45~This Furry-Free State bullshit.~sl:0.31:2~Y'know the “No Paws” Clause?~sl:0.04:1.93~A fox can't even walk down the street~sl:0~without these bloodthirsty pigs coming down on him.
Hey! Cut that shit out! We really don't need the fucking pigs coming!
You mind moving this thing a little so we can get out?
We gotta move. Drive the van.
Can you find us a way out? Use your heighted fox senses.
You picked a side today. Liberté! Égalité!
Yeah. I used my last one on that cruiser back there.
They're cool. Drives like a motherfucker. They got me away from the skin supremacists.
You don't have to go down with me! Run! Save yourself!
Just get us to the parking garage. We have a plan.
It's on Catalan Boulevard right where it hits South Vice Avenue in Tequesta. Just get there, we have a plan.
Seriously. Time to go. You're risking our location. Leave or we have to make you.
Need something bigger! No one's getting left behind!
I don't need to tell you how bad it would be to get caught, right? Lose them.
Apex to Alpha. Change of plans. Bringing in a stray. Negative, no fursuit, but they're one of us.
Shit, man, not fast enough! I gotta go!
Okay. So... what the fuck, bro?
We really need to get to your ride, let's go.
You sure I don't need a little more?
Anti-fur units are cleared to use military grade explosives. You wanna live, get in the driver's seat.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:2.23~The lanterns on the left are now extinguished,~sl:0.38~a cruel reminder of my error, but the promise of another chance.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:2~You can't leave! You can't!~sl:0.43:3.83~I've been here forever, and I'll be here forever more!~sl:0.11~Round and round we go... where we stop, no one knows...

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:2.61~The manual whispers truths, though never plainly.~sl:0.6:3.18~I must recall what has changed and when,~sl:0.11~in order to escape this place.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:3.58~October... with no indication of what year this might be.~sl:0.77~Two dates marked, one promising confinement, the other freedom.
That eerie noise once again, there must be a device nearby...

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:3.04~Success. It feels as though these devices relate~sl:0~to the lighthouse in some strange way... I should explore further.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:1.81~Another one of those contraptions;~sl:0.48~I should investigate and see if I can muster a solution.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:2.65~Venturing away from the light is surely folly;~sl:0.4~the darkness whispers promises of oblivion.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:1.78~A flicker of light lies yonder.~sl:0.47:2.24~Is this the flame of civilization,~sl:0.19~or an illusory wisp to lure me to ruin?

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:4.8~How could it be... did he somehow base this on my own experiences,~sl:0.46~or did he also find himself trapped on that cursed island?

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:4.8~Another notebook page; perhaps it can offer me precious guidance in my journey,~sl:0.55~or perhaps further riddles to drive me deeper into madness.
It would be folly to continue on this path.
The lighthouse door ahead glows with a sterile luminescence.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:3.06~A sundial... like a pocket watch,~sl:0.35~but solar powered and widely impractical.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:3.74~Time here eats itself; it chews itself up,~sl:0.27:2.32~then spits me back where I began!~sl:0.4~Munch... munch... munch!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0.47:3.11~Yesterday was last week, or- or was it today?~sl:0.73:3.83~Today... erm... yes... ye- yesterday.~sl:0.34~Well, at least I know when that is... it's tomorrow!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:1.66~Old Gramophone records...~sl:0.52:2.8~they don't appear to be the music coming from the locked room.
It's October the 20th... feels like I've been here before.
The Protocols, the answer to this riddle of stone must lie within.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:2.21~Instructions etched in faded ink,~sl:0.18:2.47~with a series of designated Protocols...~sl:0.55~What purpose did this bunker serve?

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:2.93~A steel door, half-swallowed by stone.~sl:0.41:2.53~I sense my fate lies beyond its threshold,~sl:0.66~yet I have a growing sense of dread about my path ahead.
It doesn't look like I can do much here. If only I could reset my failures.
What's this? A distant figure, or are my eyes playing tricks?

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:2.93~Something about... darkness and light?~sl:0.78~The note nearby seems to indicate a time, denoted in minutes and seconds.
You have done well to reach this stage watcher, for few of the multitude do.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:4.4~It would surely be folly to test my swimming abilities against the great abyss;~sl:0.26~my chances lie better in exploring this island.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:4.13~Each place is somehow stranger than the last. What is this place...~sl:0.43:3.53~A purgatory, a tear in the fabric of space time...~sl:0.56~or an endless nightmare, of which I cannot wake.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:2.32~I won't make any progress with trial and error,~sl:0.57~I should search my surroundings for further clues.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:3.74~A living column of wood, reaching skyward and rooting deep.~sl:0.33~It's placement feels strangely feels purposeful within these ruins.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:2.78~My only potential connection to the outside world...~sl:0.55~it seems significant to my escape from this place.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0001
en: ~sl:0:1.56~The device has reset...~sl:0.55~good fortune that I can avoid such errors in the future.
An alien sound fills my ears, growing ever louder as I approach its source.
You foolishly believe you can conquer this cycle of torment!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.06~Back for another bout of suffering?~sl:0.07:3.2~An act of bravery and resistance perhaps?~sl:0.19~Or more likely, vain indolent stupidity.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.95~Any connection between prophecy or the repeated occurrence of the number six~sl:0~is purely coincidental and simply a byproduct of confirmation bias.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.76~Citizens are reminding that early intervention saves lives.~sl:0.1~Late intervention requires significantly more ammunition.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.21~Residents are reminded that vowel sounds and plosives~sl:0~have been shown to increase transmission.
I had different routine once. Coffee. Work. Complaining about both.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:4.01~Rooftop is crawling with the infected, no chance we can land right away,~sl:0.03~hold them off while we secure our landing.
You seemed more confident a moment ago... pathetic.
Your mortal body breaks yet I persist.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.12~No wonder people were asking so many questions.~sl:0.29~Too bad they were always asking the wrong questions.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:4.54~However, I guess culture was already circling the drain for the past twenty years,~sl:0.06~so perhaps this is actually a blessing.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.15~I said you'll need gears to get that thing moving.~sl:0.01~Find them scattered across the city.
You're on clock, so step to it, find those gears and let's get you out of here.
You know you're just wasting your time here, might as well quit!
You have come too far... this wasn't in my calculations.
Now your kind must suffer forever!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.52~Citizens are reminded that "just a quick look outside"~sl:0~has resulted in over sixty-six percent of all recent infection incidents.
I assume you can talk. You're just choosing not to.
Good run, but you can do better!
Gear collected... now just find the rest.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:1.8~You know, when I thought about hell,~sl:0:2.83~I didn't have being stuck in an endless loop~sl:0:4.43~watching you get your brains devoured at the end of every day on my bingo card.
Gears, High-Rise, Chopper, you know the drill.
Thank you for your continued cooperation.
Turn back wretch, you stand at the edge of something you do not understand.
or causing individuals to pursue the living with relentless hunger.
You're onto something. Let's go again!
Hold steady, you can do this!
Lift's dead. Manual override only; get those gears scattered around the city.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:4.44~Power is out at the high-rise, so manual override of the elevator is necessary,~sl:0.15~find gears around the city to get it working again.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.98~Yet... you have not won here, mortal.~sl:0~For you were infact safer inside the loop, you haven't seen the last of me!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.47~Citizens are advised to frequently disinfect any touched surfaces,~sl:0~including door handles, countertops, and any handcrafted blunt force weaponry.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:2.32~Despite ongoing misinformation,~sl:0~I should remind all citizens that the zombie apocalypse is not an AI generated hoax.
Well... that didn't go so well.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:2.57~We had considering landing at ground level,~sl:0~but that's far too dangerous and you had been classified as disposable.
Too many infected. Hold them off till we can land.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.82~The quarantine zone, to think we thought we had this thing contained...~sl:0.34~At least you're almost out.
You're onto something this run, let's keep the momentum going!
Understand human, you are here forever in eternal torment.
The age of flesh ends not with silence, but with hunger unbound.
You're persistent, I'll give you that.
Nice, just a couple more left.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.06~You keep coming back for just one more try...~sl:0.18~You really are getting better at this. Me... less so.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0.59:3.55~You must be drawing on external sources for help.~sl:0.02:5.08~A so-called divine presence... a guide of some sort, perhaps.~sl:0.11~It said in the brochure my realm was eternal!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.8~Abandon all hope ye who enters here,~sl:0.05:2.47~for the realm of hell is full~sl:0~and now the dead are cursed to eternally walk this festering earth.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:2.54~you probably remembered me from the health announcements~sl:0.04~at the start of the outbreaks.
You really don't talk, do you? Don't know why I'm waiting for a response.
Looks like an overcast day, cloudy but at least it's dry!
Rooftop's hot. You'll need to clear it before we even think about landing.
You got this before, don't screw it up collecting the final gear.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.01~You ever notice how this always starts the same way?~sl:0.03:2.79~Me with the simple instructions followed by you~sl:0.04~getting consumed by hordes of the infected undead.
It's a brand-new day; and I have a good feeling about this one...

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:2.68~This attempt is going far too well.~sl:0.29~Fear not, though, my minions will tear you apart!
Let it be known; the gates did not break. It's your kind that opened them.
Come mortal, I have such sights to show you.
And now, well... you're living in the results. If we can even call this living.
You won't last like that, better get healed.
Freedom City is about to get wasted, kiss your slow ass goodbye!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:4.03~Find those gears, find your freedom, it's as simple as that.~sl:0.14~Minus the hordes of infected, of course!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:2.8~You know, you're not the only one stuck in this loop.~sl:0.27~Really try this time for both our sakes.
See, I knew you could salvage something, just five more left to find.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:2.57~Like I said, the power is out at the tower block.~sl:0~You need gears to get that thing moving, happy hunting.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:1.9~After the quarantine operation failed,~sl:0~plans were made to nuke this infected cesspit.
You're not looking too good, don't forget to heal.
Against all odds, you made it, now let's get the hell out of this place!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:2.44~Damn place is crawling with the infected;~sl:0.05~you're going to have to thin out the horde before we can attempt a landing.
Another gear collected, I think that's a new record!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:4.01~Day one hundred and ninety-six... damn.~sl:0.53~How many weeks have we been at this?

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:1.78~After quarantining the area failed,~sl:0:5.53~the top brass decided the only option was to wipe Freedom City off the map.~sl:0.34~I guess that ought to put a spring in your step.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.38~Peer reviewed studies prove that the zombie apocalypse is in no way~sl:0~a form of divine retribution on humanity for its fallen state.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:1.48~Maybe they were right.~sl:0.06:4.2~Perhaps it's not even a virus, maybe it's a curse....~sl:0.32~No don't be stupid, there has to be a rational explanation.
You did it. Just don't waste it.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:2~Looks like the power's out at the high-rise,~sl:0~you're going to have to drive the elevator manually.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:5.26~You know, it's kind of tiring sometimes with just me doing all the talking...~sl:0.31~That's okay, though... I respect the consistent lack of characterisation.
You know... sometimes it's kind of lonely with just me doing the talking.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.42~I guess you're more the strong stoic silent type?~sl:0.43~You could at least tell me your name, though.
You're continued silence is efficient. I respect that friend.
So... I get the sense you're not much of a talker... that's fine... I respect that.
Looks like rain today... good for ducks I suppose.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:1.88~Still standing? Good.~sl:0.08:4.55~The high-rise is waiting for you, grab those gears and let's proceed with evacuation.~sl:0~Step to it, clock is ticking.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.49~I sense sequels on the horizon,~sl:0.04~shareholders grasping greedily at greater profits, I shall return!
Pitiful mortal, your reign in this forsaken realm is over... accept your defeat.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:4.46~Your woeful defiance has almost become routine.~sl:0~Predictable. Dull. And oh, so human!
And you naively believe you can break my reign in this realm.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.89~A zombie apocalypse, I mean... really.~sl:0.16~It still sounds ridiculous when I say it out loud and yet... here we are.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.53~I thought the worst thing that could happen here was the rising rent,~sl:0.15~turned out I lacked imagination.
You did great, maybe tomorrow you'll do even better.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:1.52~You're on fire down there,~sl:0~keep blasting and we will secure a landing in no time!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:1.61~No extraction today.~sl:0~Looks like you're getting 66'000 megatons of nuclear energy instead.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:2.32~All remaining non infected residents are advised~sl:0~that evacuation measures are now in process,

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.56~How many hours have you spent in my hellish realm?~sl:0.18~Unplug, disconnect... reclaim your pathetic existence.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3~Don't you have friends, family, pets?~sl:0.02:1.87~I'm sure they need your attention,~sl:0~maybe you should consider quitting?

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:1.4~Remember Citizens:~sl:0:3.78~Eat Out to Help Out scheme has been temporarily suspended~sl:0~due to ongoing concerns regarding who is eating whom.
Residents are reminded that the infected were also once people.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:1.99~Here's where the quarantine measures failed.~sl:0.09:2.35~We still don't know how the virus is transmitted.~sl:0:2.3~To be honest, we don't even know if it is a virus...~sl:0.5~All we know is we couldn't contain it...

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:4.02~You believe you stand a chance against me and my minions?~sl:0.02~Try all you wish, mortal!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:2.4~They said I had a reassuring yet~sl:0:3.7~assertive tone that tested well on audience psychometrics.~sl:0.63~The masses still panicked, though...
Wow... that's an incredible foundation, I'm seriously impressed.
One does not simply land a chopper in Freedom City... Don't be absurd.
Time's up, tactical nukes inbound to Freedom City.
No... the cycle... it cannot be broken, how is it possible?
You are but my plaything in this hell, you will die forever in this place.
You're deteriorating fast... better patch yourself up.
I've never seen anyone come so close on their first attempt... incredible!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.58~The last heli that attempted landing at ground level didn't make it back.~sl:0.06~That high-rise is your only option.
Just hold out a little longer, in the process of securing our landing.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:2.48~This used to be the quarantine zone.~sl:0.08~We thought he had things under control; I guess we miscalculated.
Just one more left, don't mess it up this time.
Nuclear warheads armed and ready, sorry it had to be like this.
You made it! Statistically improbable but like I kept saying not impossible!
Another gear, real handy that they are scattered about the city like this.
Collect those gears then grab your ride out of here.
Walk away.... end this folly, immediately!
No... you're getting too close, it's impossible.
I guess we could call this a bit of a one-sided conversation.
Careful now, you need to get yourself patched up.
All geared up, now get to the lift and we are out of this place!
Another gear. You're getting the hang of this.
Find gears around the city to get it moving again. Good luck!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:1.77~Not one for small talk, huh?~sl:0.07~I guess you have more important things on your mind.
Not much of a talker, huh? That's fine. I can carry this.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:0.92~Weather update:~sl:0:4.06~it's a beautiful day out there in freedom city, sunshine all day.~sl:0~Happy hunting!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:2.62~Looking like a good chance of rain out there today,~sl:0.08~hope you packed your umbrella.
You know the drill by now...

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.33~You're really gearing up to something great!~sl:0.29~Hey, I'm just trying to provide motivational feedback, here.
Nice, a gear! You know what would be even better? Six gears, go find the rest.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0.15:2.06~Power is out at the High-Rise,~sl:0~the elevator to your extraction point is going to have to be driven manually.
Pathetic! You'll be here again shortly no doubt!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.47~Woe to thee of earth and sea,~sl:0.14:4.49~for your torment shall see no end,~sl:0.11~for I am the supreme lord in this realm for all eternity.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:1.73~The virus has now mutated.~sl:0.07:2.54~I repeat, the virus has now mutated.~sl:0.36~In order to slow the spread of the ongoing infection,

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.62~Citizens are instructed to continue washing their hands regularly,~sl:0:3.07~maintain strict anti-social distancing,~sl:0~and neutralize any infected individuals on sight.
never play another newly developed video game... ever again... sad, really.
We are on the clock here, get moving.
Come on, try not bleed out again.
Nice, just five more to go...

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:2.86~Elevator isn't going nowhere without those gears.~sl:0.03~Keep searching the city and head back once you have them.
You think you're stuck repeating this. You're not alone.
Different day. Same instructions. Strangely comforting, isn't it?

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.71~head to the High-Rise in the quarantine camp for immediate extraction.~sl:0.39~Your ongoing compliance is greatly appreciated.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:1.75~Pitiful human,~sl:0.05:4.04~so vain and prideful that you believe you~sl:0~can overthrow the eternal cycle of horror and agony!

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:5.21~You believed you were communicating with a product of your own making,~sl:0:2~when this whole time~sl:0~you were engineering the means to bring me forth into your realm.
Nukes incoming, better luck next time I guess!
One small hitch, power is out at the high rise.
I've got a good feeling about this time...
Now you just have to find one more... again.
Get going, I hope it's easier than last time.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.69~This, however, does not change the recommended health procedure response~sl:0~of bludgeoning the prefrontal cortex until unresponsive

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:1.97~Please reach out to your local health officials~sl:0~for visual aids to assist with this process.
I get it you're all action, no dialogue. Figures.
You got this... just a little longer.
That's all six gears, now get to the lift and let's get you out of this place.
Two gears down, four more to go.
Hurry up with those gears and get to the elevator at the quarantine zone.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:2.93~You made a terrible mistake back there,~sl:0:3.74~you have no chance of survival this time.~sl:0.26~Why not abort now and end your suffering?
You were never supposed to get this far... how is this possible?

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3~And still the cycle persists;~sl:0.01:6.19~Pitiful sapient, you believe you can break the wheel of torment.~sl:0~Your efforts are but futile. Abandon all hope.
Weather update: low visibility. Good for hiding... bad for surviving.
Here come the bones crew again!
Holy fucking shit... what is that thing?
Looks like you're about to become a dead guy's lunch... again.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:3.07~This was the quarantine zone, poor souls...~sl:0.42~Elevator to the high-rise is nearby.
Woohoo! That's the best you've done so far. You're really on it today.
You ran out the clock, and now unfortunately you're toast.
Citizens are advised to avoid all forms of emotional attachment during these difficult times.
Cloud and overcast, perfect zombie killing conditions!
Not looking too good down there, better heal those wounds.
Gears collected, now reach the lift at the high rise.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:1.19~Heli is on its way.~sl:0~Grab those gears and reach the rooftop before this place is toast.
Something changed. Stop adapting for I shall merely update the source code!
Another vain attempt by a pathetic heap of animated man flesh.
You keep doing the surviving, I'll keep doing the talking.
You did well. Let's build on that.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
en: ~sl:0:1.34~You got another one!~sl:0.01:4.67~No idea why they are strategically placed around the city like this~sl:0.03~rather than all in one place.

group: Phụ đề hội thoại | Minigame M0002
